assertions.assertion: Explains that Client.UpdateAccessTokenClaimsOnRefresh defaults to false, so refreshed tokens reuse the original claims and only IsActiveAsync is called
assertions.rationale: States UpdateAccessTokenClaimsOnRefresh defaults to false, original claims reused, only IsActiveAsync is called on refresh.

assertions.assertion: Shows setting Client.UpdateAccessTokenClaimsOnRefresh = true to re-invoke GetProfileDataAsync on refresh
Explains this makes refreshed access-token claims reflect the current state from the profile service
assertions.rationale: States IdentityServer re-runs GetProfileDataAsync on refresh so roles reflect current state.
